tool.name: OGS: PVTU2VTU
tool.description: This tool merges VTU files of PVTU into one single VTU file.
tool.command: #import re ln -sf '$input' 'input.pvtu'; #set $safe_names = [re.sub(r'[^\w\-.@]', '_', str($item.element_identifier)) for $item in $input_members] #if len($safe_names) != len(set($safe_names)) #set $joined = ', '.join($safe_names) echo 'error: the element identifiers map to the same file name after characters outside [A-Za-z0-9_.@-] are replaced by _: $joined' >&2; exit 1; #end if #for $item in $input_members #set $safe_name = re.sub(r'[^\w\-.@]', '_', str($item.element_identifier)) ln -sf '$item' '$safe_name'; #end for #if $original_mesh ln -sf '$original_mesh' 'original_mesh.vtu'; #end if pvtu2vtu --input 'input.pvtu' #if $original_mesh --original_mesh 'original_mesh.vtu' #end if $compress --output output_1.vtu

param.label: input
param.help: Input (.pvtu). The partitioned input mesh file

param.name: input_members
param.label: input referenced files
param.help: Partitioned mesh parts referenced by the .pvtu header. Their names must match the <Piece Source=...> entries.

param.label: original mesh
param.help: Input (.vtu). The original unpartitioned input mesh (optional)

tool.help: This tool merges VTU files of PVTU into one single VTU file. Apart from the mesh data, all property data are merged as well
